definitions.explanation: A general term for cereal grains including wheat, barley, oats, and rye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{麦茶|むぎちゃ}→麦茶：16494_mugicha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
{麦|むぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まいて、⟦{初夏|しょか}→初夏：11740_shoka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Wheat and barley are sown in autumn and harvested in early summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧、{麦|むぎ}⟦わら→わら：27567_wara⟧⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶって→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧{麦|むぎ}⟦{畑|ばたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: When summer came, I would put on a straw hat and walk through the wheat fields.

notes:
{麦|むぎ} is the umbrella term for wheat, barley, rye, and oats; English has no single everyday word for this group. Use ⟦{小麦|こむぎ}→小麦：01407_komugi⟧ or ⟦{大麦|おおむぎ}→大麦：12215_oomugi⟧ when the kind matters.

TYPES:
- ⟦{小麦|こむぎ}→小麦：01407_komugi⟧: wheat (bread, noodles, flour)
- ⟦{大麦|おおむぎ}→大麦：12215_oomugi⟧: barley (tea, beer, {麦|むぎ}ご{飯|はん})
- ⟦ライ{麦|むぎ}→ライ麦：23185_raimugi⟧: rye
- オーツ{麦|むぎ} / {燕麦|えんばく}: oats

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{麦茶|むぎちゃ}→麦茶：16494_mugicha⟧: roasted barley tea, the standard cold drink of a Japanese summer
- {麦|むぎ}ご{飯|はん}: rice cooked with barley
- {麦|むぎ}わら⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧: straw hat
- {麦|むぎ}{畑|ばたけ}: wheat or barley field
